reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown argue the exception lies in the sinner's settled rejection, not sin's nature, since Matthew 12:31 itself calls all sin forgivable.

sides.snippet: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.
sides.verseText: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.

sides.snippet: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
